def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    tightness = 1.0 / (rem[valid] + 1e-7)
    fill_ratio = item / (bins[valid] + 1e-7)
    scores[valid] = tightness + fill_ratio
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    original_capacities = bins[valid] - rem[valid] + item
    fraction = rem[valid] / (original_capacities + 1e-7)
    
    scores[valid] = -np.abs(fraction - 0.5) + (1.0 / (rem[valid] + 1e-5))
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    
    orig = bins[valid] - rem[valid] + item
    frac = rem[valid] / (orig + 1e-7)
    
    scores[valid] = -np.abs(frac - 0.5) + (1.5 / (rem[valid] + 1e-5))
    return scores
